units.source_text: 且说内大臣最近找到了那个女儿近江君之后，

en.t: Now, after the Minister of the Interior had recently found that daughter of his, Lady Omi,

units.source_text: 邸内上下人等对此事都不赞许，大家看不起她。

en.t: everyone in the household, high and low, disapproved of the matter and looked down on her.

units.source_text: 世人也都讥评为无聊之事。

en.t: People in the world also mocked it as a foolish affair.

units.source_text: 此种诽议，内大臣都听到。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior heard all these criticisms.

units.source_text: 有一天，弁少将在谈话中乘便说起：

en.t: One day, in the course of conversation, Ben no Shosho happened to mention it:

units.source_text: “太政大臣曾经问他是否真有其事。”

en.t: “The Chancellor once asked him whether it was really true.”

units.source_text: 内大臣笑道：“当然有啰！

en.t: The Minister of the Interior laughed and said, “Of course it is true!

units.source_text: 他自己不是迎来了一个素不知名的乡下姑娘，费尽心计地教养她么？

en.t: Did he not himself take in an utterly unknown country girl and go to great pains to raise her?

units.source_text: 这位大臣向来不喜议论别人，独有对于我家之事，特别注意，并且加以讥评。

en.t: That minister has never liked talking about other people, yet he pays special attention to my household affairs and criticizes them.

units.source_text: 这在我倒觉得很光荣呢。”

en.t: For my part, I actually find that quite an honor.”

units.source_text: 弁少将说：“住在西厅里的那个人，听说长得非常漂亮，无瑕可指。

en.t: Ben no Shosho said, “The lady living in the western wing is said to be extraordinarily beautiful, without a flaw to point to.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王等热心地向她求婚，正在为她烦恼呢。

en.t: Prince Hyobukyo and others are earnestly courting her and are quite troubled over her.

units.source_text: 大家都猜量这不是一个寻常的美人。”

en.t: Everyone supposes she must be no ordinary beauty.”

units.source_text: 内大臣说：“不见得吧！

en.t: The Minister of the Interior said, “I doubt that!

units.source_text: 只因她是源氏太政大臣的女儿，所以大家凭空猜量，极口称赞。

en.t: Only because she is the daughter of Genji the Chancellor, everyone imagines things without basis and praises her to the skies.

units.source_text: 世间人情往往如此。

en.t: That is often how people in the world behave.

units.source_text: 我看未必是个美人吧。

en.t: I do not think she is necessarily a beauty.

units.source_text: 如果真是美人，应该早就闻名了。

en.t: If she were truly beautiful, her name should already have become known.

units.source_text: 这位大臣位尊名重，无忧无虑，享尽荣华富贵。

en.t: This minister holds high rank and great fame, lives without worries, and has enjoyed every splendor and wealth.

units.source_text: 只可惜子女太少。

en.t: The only pity is that he has far too few children.

units.source_text: 最好有个正妻所生的女儿，悉心教养，使她长得美玉无疵，大受世人艳羡。

en.t: It would be best if he had a daughter born of his principal wife, raised her with great care, and made her grow up flawless as a jewel, greatly admired by the world.

units.source_text: 然而他家没有这样的人，而且侧室所生的也极稀少，这未免太寂寞了。

en.t: But his household has no such person, and even children born of concubines are extremely few, which is rather lonely.

units.source_text: 明石姬所生的女儿，母亲出身低微，然而宿世福缘不浅，前程倒很远大呢。

en.t: As for the daughter born to Lady Akashi, her mother is of low birth, yet her fortune from former lives is deep, and her prospects are quite grand.

units.source_text: 至于你所说的那个，也许不是亲生女儿。

en.t: As for the one you spoke of, perhaps she is not his natural daughter.

units.source_text: 这位大臣毕竟是个脾气古怪的人，可能干这种勾当。”

en.t: After all, that minister is an eccentric man, and he might well do such a thing.”

units.source_text: 他如此贬斥玉鬘。

en.t: In this way he disparaged Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 又说：“但不知她的亲事如何定夺。

en.t: He also said, “Still, I wonder how her marriage will be decided.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王大约可以到手的吧。

en.t: Prince Hyobukyo will probably be able to win her, I suppose.

units.source_text: 他和太政大臣交情特厚，人品也很优越，倒是门当户对的。”

en.t: He is especially close to the Chancellor, and his character is excellent, so they would in fact be well matched.”

units.source_text: 此时他想起了自己的女儿云居雁，觉得很不满意，

en.t: At this point he thought of his own daughter, Kumoi no Kari, and felt deeply dissatisfied,

units.source_text: 希望她也像玉鬘那样受人仰慕，使得许多男子焦灼不安地猜测谁是乘龙快婿。

en.t: wishing that she too were admired like Tamakazura, making many men anxiously wonder who would become the fortunate son-in-law.

units.source_text: 妬羡之余，决定在夕雾官位未升期间，不将云居雁许配与他。

en.t: Out of envy and resentment, he decided that until Yugiri's official rank rose, he would not give Kumoi no Kari to him in marriage.

units.source_text: 但倘源氏启口，诚恳请求，则亦不妨让步，允其所请。

en.t: Yet if Genji spoke up and asked sincerely, he would not mind yielding and granting the request.

units.source_text: 无奈夕雾毫不着急，内大臣心甚不快。

en.t: Unfortunately, Yugiri showed no urgency at all, and the Minister of the Interior was very displeased.

units.source_text: 他这般那般地筹思了一会，突然起身，漫步走向云居雁的房间。

en.t: After pondering this and that for a while, he suddenly rose and strolled toward Kumoi no Kari's room.

units.source_text: 弁少将陪着他同行。

en.t: Ben no Shosho accompanied him as he went.
